# sports-video-coach

> Open-source, agent-first sports video analysis and basketball analytics. Turn a game or training video into
> timestamped film review, coaching reports with clips/narration, drills and explained MP4s.

## Start here

- [START.md](START.md): the step-by-step path for an agent whose user pasted the one prompt ("Coach me on my
  sports video: <path>. Clone this repo and follow its START.md."): check tools, ask once, install pinned, run to
  exit 0, hand over, next step, star ask.
- [README](README.md): overview, demo, setup and limitations.
- [Chinese README](README.zh.md): Chinese overview and setup.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): repository and runtime contract for coding agents.
- [Full capability catalog](docs/features.md): implemented features, commands, prerequisites and advantages.
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): detailed guides.

## Runtime entry points

- `sports-video-coach plugins --json`: discover installed plugins and requirements.
- `sports-video-coach run <video> --sport <sport> --lang en`: generic sports coaching; no GPU required.
- `hoop-tape-miner run <league-link-or-game-folder>`: basketball game workflow.
- `hoop-tape-miner train <videos-or-session-folder>`: basketball training review.
- `hoop-tape-miner move <session-input>`: movement-session workflow; inspect `--help` for inputs.
- Exit 3 requests a named agent artifact and guide; complete it and resume the same unit. Exit 0 means done.

## Basketball and perception

- [Basketball guide](docs/basketball.md): team/player pages, tracking, stats, shots and coaching.
- [Playbook](docs/playbook.md): exact end-to-end procedures.
- [OpenHoopVision](docs/perception.md): optional candidate evidence, reviews and validation media.
- [WASB, SAHI and KaliCalib](docs/perception-lab.md): optional local model adapters, independent evaluation,
  measured limitations and reproducibility. Run `hoop-tape-miner perception-lab --help`.

## Extend and evaluate

- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): sport-independent core and plugin hooks.
- [Plugins](docs/plugins.md): scaffolding and examples for new sports.
- [Benchmark](docs/benchmark.md): synthetic film-review tasks with exact ground truth.
- [Coaching knowledge base](docs/knowledge-base.md): the four basketball KBs (team, skill, movement, fuel and
  recovery), entry structure, how runs cite them, source rules and how to contribute an entry or a sport KB.
- [Privacy](docs/privacy.md): local workspace, model-provider boundaries and deliberate sharing.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): tests, PR workflow and no real player data in public contributions.

Automatic detections are candidates. Never promote model scores to official results, invent unseen actions,
or publish private video/report data without authorization. This index aids navigation; it is not a search-ranking guarantee.
